dialogue.text: She is Empress, beloved by Franz Joseph, beloved by the people.
dialogue.zh: She is Empress, beloved by Franz Joseph, beloved by the people.
dialogue.ja: 彼女は皇后であり、フランツ・ヨーゼフと国民に愛されています。
dialogue.local: She is Empress, beloved by Franz Joseph, beloved by the people.
dialogue.en: She is Empress, beloved by Franz Joseph, beloved by the people.

dialogue.text: Yet she is not happy. Her children are taken from her. She stoves flees away to Hungary to England.
dialogue.zh: Yet she is not happy. Her children are taken from her. She stoves flees away to Hungary to England.
dialogue.ja: しかし、彼女は幸せではありません。子供たちは彼女から奪われました。彼女は匈牙利へ、そしてイングランドへ逃げました。
dialogue.local: Yet she is not happy. Her children are taken from her. She stoves flees away to Hungary to England.
dialogue.en: Yet she is not happy. Her children are taken from her. She stoves flees away to Hungary to England.

dialogue.text: She is the triumph and her deepest sorrow.
dialogue.zh: She is the triumph and her deepest sorrow.
dialogue.ja: 彼女は勝利であり、最も深い悲しみでもあります。
dialogue.local: She is the triumph and her deepest sorrow.
dialogue.en: She is the triumph and her deepest sorrow.

dialogue.text: Elizabeth became an early mother. At 17, she gave birth to her first child, little Sophie.
dialogue.zh: Elizabeth became an early mother. At 17, she gave birth to her first child, little Sophie.
dialogue.ja: エリザベートは若くして母親になりました。17歳で最初の子供、小さなソフィーを産みました。
dialogue.local: Elizabeth became an early mother. At 17, she gave birth to her first child, little Sophie.
dialogue.en: Elizabeth became an early mother. At 17, she gave birth to her first child, little Sophie.

dialogue.text: Hardly born, Archduches Sophie took the child from her.
dialogue.zh: Hardly born, Archduches Sophie took the child from her.
dialogue.ja: 生まれたばかりの子供を、大公女ソフィーが彼女から奪い取りました。
dialogue.local: Hardly born, Archduches Sophie took the child from her.
dialogue.en: Hardly born, Archduches Sophie took the child from her.

dialogue.text: She dictated the clothing and the daily routine.
dialogue.zh: She dictated the clothing and the daily routine.
dialogue.ja: 彼女は子供の服装や日課を指示しました。
dialogue.local: She dictated the clothing and the daily routine.
dialogue.en: She dictated the clothing and the daily routine.

dialogue.text: Elizabeth was only allowed to see her daughter at scheduled times.
dialogue.zh: Elizabeth was only allowed to see her daughter at scheduled times.
dialogue.ja: エリザベートは決められた時間にしか娘に会うことが許されませんでした。
dialogue.local: Elizabeth was only allowed to see her daughter at scheduled times.
dialogue.en: Elizabeth was only allowed to see her daughter at scheduled times.

dialogue.text: In 1857, the 20-year-old Sissy accompanied her husband on a trip to Hungary.
dialogue.zh: In 1857, the 20-year-old Sissy accompanied her husband on a trip to Hungary.
dialogue.ja: 1857年、20歳のシシィは夫と共にハンガリーへ旅に出ました。
dialogue.local: In 1857, the 20-year-old Sissy accompanied her husband on a trip to Hungary.
dialogue.en: In 1857, the 20-year-old Sissy accompanied her husband on a trip to Hungary.

dialogue.text: Against Dr.'s advice, she takes two-year-old Sophie with her, who falls gravely ill and dies at just two years old.
dialogue.zh: Against Dr.'s advice, she takes two-year-old Sophie with her, who falls gravely ill and dies at just two years old.
dialogue.ja: 医師の助言に反して、彼女は2歳のソフィーを連れて行きましたが、ソフィーは重病にかかり、2歳で亡くなりました。
dialogue.local: Against Dr.'s advice, she takes two-year-old Sophie with her, who falls gravely ill and dies at just two years old.
dialogue.en: Against Dr.'s advice, she takes two-year-old Sophie with her, who falls gravely ill and dies at just two years old.

dialogue.text: For Elizabeth, it's a shock. The public holds her responsible. They claim she subjected the child to the hardships.
dialogue.zh: For Elizabeth, it's a shock. The public holds her responsible. They claim she subjected the child to the hardships.
dialogue.ja: エリザベートにとって、それは衝撃でした。世間は彼女を責め、子供に苦難を与えたと非難しました。
dialogue.local: For Elizabeth, it's a shock. The public holds her responsible. They claim she subjected the child to the hardships.
dialogue.en: For Elizabeth, it's a shock. The public holds her responsible. They claim she subjected the child to the hardships.

dialogue.text: Sissy falls into depression. I can't take it anymore.
dialogue.zh: Sissy falls into depression. I can't take it anymore.
dialogue.ja: シシィはうつ状態に陥りました。もう耐えられません。
dialogue.local: Sissy falls into depression. I can't take it anymore.
dialogue.en: Sissy falls into depression. I can't take it anymore.

dialogue.text: She withdraws, leaving the upbringing of the other children entirely to her mother-in-law.
dialogue.zh: She withdraws, leaving the upbringing of the other children entirely to her mother-in-law.
dialogue.ja: 彼女は引きこもり、他の子供たちの育児を完全に姑に任せました。
dialogue.local: She withdraws, leaving the upbringing of the other children entirely to her mother-in-law.
dialogue.en: She withdraws, leaving the upbringing of the other children entirely to her mother-in-law.

dialogue.text: A year after Sophie, Gisela is born, a well-behaved, conforming child, diligent, obedient, conventional.
dialogue.zh: A year after Sophie, Gisela is born, a well-behaved, conforming child, diligent, obedient, conventional.
dialogue.ja: ソフィーの1年後にギーゼラが生まれました。彼女はおとなしく、従順で、勤勉で、伝統的な子供でした。
dialogue.local: A year after Sophie, Gisela is born, a well-behaved, conforming child, diligent, obedient, conventional.
dialogue.en: A year after Sophie, Gisela is born, a well-behaved, conforming child, diligent, obedient, conventional.

dialogue.text: The opposite of her mother, there is never any closeness between them.
dialogue.zh: The opposite of her mother, there is never any closeness between them.
dialogue.ja: 彼女は母親とは正反対で、二人の間に親密さはありませんでした。
dialogue.local: The opposite of her mother, there is never any closeness between them.
dialogue.en: The opposite of her mother, there is never any closeness between them.

dialogue.text: In 1858, the longed four-air Rudolph is born.
dialogue.zh: In 1858, the longed four-air Rudolph is born.
dialogue.ja: 1858年、待望の四男ルドルフが生まれました。
dialogue.local: In 1858, the longed four-air Rudolph is born.
dialogue.en: In 1858, the longed four-air Rudolph is born.

dialogue.text: Elizabeth is 20 years old, but he also becomes estranged from her.
dialogue.zh: Elizabeth is 20 years old, but he also becomes estranged from her.
dialogue.ja: エリザベートは20歳ですが、彼も彼女から疎遠になりました。
dialogue.local: Elizabeth is 20 years old, but he also becomes estranged from her.
dialogue.en: Elizabeth is 20 years old, but he also becomes estranged from her.

dialogue.text: At the age of five, he is handed over to a harsh tutor.
dialogue.zh: At the age of five, he is handed over to a harsh tutor.
dialogue.ja: 5歳の時、彼は厳しい家庭教師に預けられました。
dialogue.local: At the age of five, he is handed over to a harsh tutor.
dialogue.en: At the age of five, he is handed over to a harsh tutor.

dialogue.text: The training is in human, wake up calls with gunshots, marches in the cold, intimidation.
dialogue.zh: The training is in human, wake up calls with gunshots, marches in the cold, intimidation.
dialogue.ja: 訓練は過酷で、銃声で起こされ、寒さの中で行進し、威嚇されました。
dialogue.local: The training is in human, wake up calls with gunshots, marches in the cold, intimidation.
dialogue.en: The training is in human, wake up calls with gunshots, marches in the cold, intimidation.

dialogue.text: Rudolph almost breaks under it.
dialogue.zh: Rudolph almost breaks under it.
dialogue.ja: ルドルフはそれにほとんど耐えられませんでした。
dialogue.local: Rudolph almost breaks under it.
dialogue.en: Rudolph almost breaks under it.

dialogue.text: That's when 23-year-old Elizabeth steps in for the first time.
dialogue.zh: That's when 23-year-old Elizabeth steps in for the first time.
dialogue.ja: その時、23歳のエリザベートが初めて介入しました。
dialogue.local: That's when 23-year-old Elizabeth steps in for the first time.
dialogue.en: That's when 23-year-old Elizabeth steps in for the first time.

dialogue.text: She presents Franz Joseph with an ultimatum, either the tutor leaves or I will.
dialogue.zh: She presents Franz Joseph with an ultimatum, either the tutor leaves or I will.
dialogue.ja: 彼女はフランツ・ヨーゼフに最後通告を出しました。家庭教師が去るか、私が去るかどちらかです。
dialogue.local: She presents Franz Joseph with an ultimatum, either the tutor leaves or I will.
dialogue.en: She presents Franz Joseph with an ultimatum, either the tutor leaves or I will.

dialogue.text: An unheard of move for an Empress, but the Emperor gives in, Rudolph gets a gentler teacher.
dialogue.zh: An unheard of move for an Empress, but the Emperor gives in, Rudolph gets a gentler teacher.
dialogue.ja: 皇后としては前代未聞の行動でしたが、皇帝は折れ、ルドルフにはより優しい教師がつきました。
dialogue.local: An unheard of move for an Empress, but the Emperor gives in, Rudolph gets a gentler teacher.
dialogue.en: An unheard of move for an Empress, but the Emperor gives in, Rudolph gets a gentler teacher.

dialogue.text: Sissy has achieved her first victory.
dialogue.zh: Sissy has achieved her first victory.
dialogue.ja: シシィは最初の勝利を手に入れました。
dialogue.local: Sissy has achieved her first victory.
dialogue.en: Sissy has achieved her first victory.

dialogue.text: Yet deep inside, she remains torn apart. The defeats as a mother have left lasting scars.
dialogue.zh: Yet deep inside, she remains torn apart. The defeats as a mother have left lasting scars.
dialogue.ja: しかし内心では、彼女は引き裂かれたままです。母親としての敗北は深い傷を残しました。
dialogue.local: Yet deep inside, she remains torn apart. The defeats as a mother have left lasting scars.
dialogue.en: Yet deep inside, she remains torn apart. The defeats as a mother have left lasting scars.

dialogue.text: Elizabeth crafts her own weapons. She stoves, tightens her corset painfully, achieving a wasp waste that shocks all.
dialogue.zh: Elizabeth crafts her own weapons. She stoves, tightens her corset painfully, achieving a wasp waste that shocks all.
dialogue.ja: エリザベートは自分の武器を作り出しました。彼女は食事制限をし、痛みを伴いながらコルセットを締め、みんなを驚かせる細いウエストを手に入れました。
dialogue.local: Elizabeth crafts her own weapons. She stoves, tightens her corset painfully, achieving a wasp waste that shocks all.
dialogue.en: Elizabeth crafts her own weapons. She stoves, tightens her corset painfully, achieving a wasp waste that shocks all.

dialogue.text: She exercises like a maniac, rides, marches, drives, carriages, even smokes.
dialogue.zh: She exercises like a maniac, rides, marches, drives, carriages, even smokes.
dialogue.ja: 彼女は狂ったように運動し、乗馬し、行進し、馬車を操り、さらには喫煙もしました。
dialogue.local: She exercises like a maniac, rides, marches, drives, carriages, even smokes.
dialogue.en: She exercises like a maniac, rides, marches, drives, carriages, even smokes.

dialogue.text: Her body turns into a battlefield and protest, but it collapses, fever, cough, exhaustion.
dialogue.zh: Her body turns into a battlefield and protest, but it collapses, fever, cough, exhaustion.
dialogue.ja: 彼女の体は戦場であり抗議の場となりましたが、やがて崩れ、熱、咳、疲労に襲われました。
dialogue.local: Her body turns into a battlefield and protest, but it collapses, fever, cough, exhaustion.
dialogue.en: Her body turns into a battlefield and protest, but it collapses, fever, cough, exhaustion.

dialogue.text: I can't take it anymore. Majesty, you must rest.
dialogue.zh: I can't take it anymore. Majesty, you must rest.
dialogue.ja: もう耐えられません。陛下、休まなければなりません。
dialogue.local: I can't take it anymore. Majesty, you must rest.
dialogue.en: I can't take it anymore. Majesty, you must rest.

dialogue.text: The doctors sent her to Madeira and Venice. She is recovering, but she will never be healthy again.
dialogue.zh: The doctors sent her to Madeira and Venice. She is recovering, but she will never be healthy again.
dialogue.ja: 医師たちは彼女をマデイラとヴェネツィアに送りました。彼女は回復していますが、二度と健康には戻れません。
dialogue.local: The doctors sent her to Madeira and Venice. She is recovering, but she will never be healthy again.
dialogue.en: The doctors sent her to Madeira and Venice. She is recovering, but she will never be healthy again.

dialogue.text: These journeys, however, open up a new world for her, the escape.
dialogue.zh: These journeys, however, open up a new world for her, the escape.
dialogue.ja: しかしこれらの旅は彼女に新しい世界、逃避の場を開きました。
dialogue.local: These journeys, however, open up a new world for her, the escape.
dialogue.en: These journeys, however, open up a new world for her, the escape.

dialogue.text: Travel becomes her outlet, her method of breaking free from the confines of the prison.
dialogue.zh: Travel becomes her outlet, her method of breaking free from the confines of the prison.
dialogue.ja: 旅は彼女の逃げ場となり、牢獄の束縛から解放される手段となりました。
dialogue.local: Travel becomes her outlet, her method of breaking free from the confines of the prison.
dialogue.en: Travel becomes her outlet, her method of breaking free from the confines of the prison.

dialogue.text: As early as 1857, the 20-year-old Elizabeth had fallen in love with Hungary,
dialogue.zh: As early as 1857, the 20-year-old Elizabeth had fallen in love with Hungary,
dialogue.ja: 早くも1857年に、20歳のエリザベートはハンガリーに恋をしていました。
dialogue.local: As early as 1857, the 20-year-old Elizabeth had fallen in love with Hungary,
dialogue.en: As early as 1857, the 20-year-old Elizabeth had fallen in love with Hungary,

dialogue.text: a country that is different from Vienna, wild, proud, full of life.
dialogue.zh: a country that is different from Vienna, wild, proud, full of life.
dialogue.ja: ウィーンとは異なる国で、野性的で誇り高く、生き生きとしています。
dialogue.local: a country that is different from Vienna, wild, proud, full of life.
dialogue.en: a country that is different from Vienna, wild, proud, full of life.

dialogue.text: She adores the dances, the music, and the freedom, and the people adore her.
dialogue.zh: She adores the dances, the music, and the freedom, and the people adore her.
dialogue.ja: 彼女は踊りや音楽、自由を愛し、人々も彼女を愛しました。
dialogue.local: She adores the dances, the music, and the freedom, and the people adore her.
dialogue.en: She adores the dances, the music, and the freedom, and the people adore her.

dialogue.text: 1862, Elizabeth is 25 and surprises the court.
dialogue.zh: 1862, Elizabeth is 25 and surprises the court.
dialogue.ja: 1862年、エリザベートは25歳で宮廷を驚かせました。
dialogue.local: 1862, Elizabeth is 25 and surprises the court.
dialogue.en: 1862, Elizabeth is 25 and surprises the court.

dialogue.text: She wants to learn Hungarian. Her teacher, Eda von Ferrense, becomes her confidante.
dialogue.zh: She wants to learn Hungarian. Her teacher, Eda von Ferrense, becomes her confidante.
dialogue.ja: 彼女はハンガリー語を学びたいと思い、教師のエダ・フォン・フェレンスは彼女の信頼できる友人になりました。
dialogue.local: She wants to learn Hungarian. Her teacher, Eda von Ferrense, becomes her confidante.
dialogue.en: She wants to learn Hungarian. Her teacher, Eda von Ferrense, becomes her confidante.

dialogue.text: They practice for hours, often during hairstyling. No one understands what she's saying.
dialogue.zh: They practice for hours, often during hairstyling. No one understands what she's saying.
dialogue.ja: 彼女たちは何時間も練習し、よく髪を整えている間に行いました。誰も彼女の言っていることを理解しませんでした。
dialogue.local: They practice for hours, often during hairstyling. No one understands what she's saying.
dialogue.en: They practice for hours, often during hairstyling. No one understands what she's saying.

dialogue.text: Hungarian becomes her secret language.
dialogue.zh: Hungarian becomes her secret language.
dialogue.ja: ハンガリー語は彼女の秘密の言葉になりました。
dialogue.local: Hungarian becomes her secret language.
dialogue.en: Hungarian becomes her secret language.

dialogue.text: Through Eda, she also reaches the ideas of the liberals.
dialogue.zh: Through Eda, she also reaches the ideas of the liberals.
dialogue.ja: エダを通じて、彼女は自由主義者の考えにも触れました。
dialogue.local: Through Eda, she also reaches the ideas of the liberals.
dialogue.en: Through Eda, she also reaches the ideas of the liberals.

dialogue.text: Count Andrasi, names that are considered dangerous in Vienna.
dialogue.zh: Count Andrasi, names that are considered dangerous in Vienna.
dialogue.ja: アンドラーシ伯爵、その名前はウィーンでは危険視されていました。
dialogue.local: Count Andrasi, names that are considered dangerous in Vienna.
dialogue.en: Count Andrasi, names that are considered dangerous in Vienna.

dialogue.text: For Elizabeth, it's more than just politics.
dialogue.zh: For Elizabeth, it's more than just politics.
dialogue.ja: エリザベートにとって、それは単なる政治以上のものでした。
dialogue.local: For Elizabeth, it's more than just politics.
dialogue.en: For Elizabeth, it's more than just politics.

dialogue.text: Hungary will become her second home. Here, she finds what Vienna denies her. Recognition and love.
dialogue.zh: Hungary will become her second home. Here, she finds what Vienna denies her. Recognition and love.
dialogue.ja: ハンガリーは彼女の第二の故郷となります。ここで彼女はウィーンが拒んだもの、認められ愛されることを見つけました。
dialogue.local: Hungary will become her second home. Here, she finds what Vienna denies her. Recognition and love.
dialogue.en: Hungary will become her second home. Here, she finds what Vienna denies her. Recognition and love.

dialogue.text: Then comes the pivotal year of 1866.
dialogue.zh: Then comes the pivotal year of 1866.
dialogue.ja: そして1866年という重要な年が訪れます。
dialogue.local: Then comes the pivotal year of 1866.
dialogue.en: Then comes the pivotal year of 1866.

dialogue.text: Elizabeth is 29 years old. Austria wages war against Prussia and Italy.
dialogue.zh: Elizabeth is 29 years old. Austria wages war against Prussia and Italy.
dialogue.ja: エリザベートは29歳。オーストリアはプロイセンとイタリアに戦争を仕掛けました。
dialogue.local: Elizabeth is 29 years old. Austria wages war against Prussia and Italy.
dialogue.en: Elizabeth is 29 years old. Austria wages war against Prussia and Italy.

dialogue.text: At Coney Gratz, the empire suffers a catastrophic defeat.
dialogue.zh: At Coney Gratz, the empire suffers a catastrophic defeat.
dialogue.ja: コーニーグラーツで帝国は壊滅的な敗北を喫しました。
dialogue.local: At Coney Gratz, the empire suffers a catastrophic defeat.
dialogue.en: At Coney Gratz, the empire suffers a catastrophic defeat.

dialogue.text: The monarchy teeters perilously on the edge of the abyss.
dialogue.zh: The monarchy teeters perilously on the edge of the abyss.
dialogue.ja: 君主制は危険なほど崖っぷちに立たされています。
dialogue.local: The monarchy teeters perilously on the edge of the abyss.
dialogue.en: The monarchy teeters perilously on the edge of the abyss.

dialogue.text: Elizabeth flees to Hungary with the children, a political stroke of luck, as her presence calms the country.
dialogue.zh: Elizabeth flees to Hungary with the children, a political stroke of luck, as her presence calms the country.
dialogue.ja: エリザベートは子供たちと共にハンガリーへ逃げました。彼女の存在が国を落ち着かせたため、政治的な幸運でした。
dialogue.local: Elizabeth flees to Hungary with the children, a political stroke of luck, as her presence calms the country.
dialogue.en: Elizabeth flees to Hungary with the children, a political stroke of luck, as her presence calms the country.

dialogue.text: The Hungarians deeply admire her and heed her words.
dialogue.zh: The Hungarians deeply admire her and heed her words.
dialogue.ja: ハンガリー人は彼女を深く敬愛し、彼女の言葉に耳を傾けました。
dialogue.local: The Hungarians deeply admire her and heed her words.
dialogue.en: The Hungarians deeply admire her and heed her words.

dialogue.text: In Budapest, Count Andrasi successfully gains her influence.
dialogue.zh: In Budapest, Count Andrasi successfully gains her influence.
dialogue.ja: ブダペストでアンドラーシ伯爵は彼女の影響力を得ることに成功しました。
dialogue.local: In Budapest, Count Andrasi successfully gains her influence.
dialogue.en: In Budapest, Count Andrasi successfully gains her influence.

dialogue.text: He persuades her that only a compromise with Hungary can save the monarchy.
dialogue.zh: He persuades her that only a compromise with Hungary can save the monarchy.
dialogue.ja: 彼は彼女に、ハンガリーとの妥協だけが君主制を救えると説得しました。
dialogue.local: He persuades her that only a compromise with Hungary can save the monarchy.
dialogue.en: He persuades her that only a compromise with Hungary can save the monarchy.

dialogue.text: CC urges Franz Joseph finally make peace now.
dialogue.zh: CC urges Franz Joseph finally make peace now.
dialogue.ja: CCはフランツ・ヨーゼフに今こそ和平を結ぶよう促しました。
dialogue.local: CC urges Franz Joseph finally make peace now.
dialogue.en: CC urges Franz Joseph finally make peace now.

dialogue.text: But the emperor hesitates, since 1848 he has ruled authoritatively.
dialogue.zh: But the emperor hesitates, since 1848 he has ruled authoritatively.
dialogue.ja: しかし皇帝はためらいました。1848年以来、彼は権威的に統治してきました。
dialogue.local: But the emperor hesitates, since 1848 he has ruled authoritatively.
dialogue.en: But the emperor hesitates, since 1848 he has ruled authoritatively.

dialogue.text: He fears being bound by a coronation.
dialogue.zh: He fears being bound by a coronation.
dialogue.ja: 彼は戴冠式に縛られることを恐れています。
dialogue.local: He fears being bound by a coronation.
dialogue.en: He fears being bound by a coronation.

dialogue.text: To a people, to a constitution, he has no other choice left.
dialogue.zh: To a people, to a constitution, he has no other choice left.
dialogue.ja: 国民や憲法に対して、彼には他の選択肢が残されていません。
dialogue.local: To a people, to a constitution, he has no other choice left.
dialogue.en: To a people, to a constitution, he has no other choice left.

dialogue.text: The defeat was far too devastating.
dialogue.zh: The defeat was far too devastating.
dialogue.ja: 敗北はあまりにも壊滅的でした。
dialogue.local: The defeat was far too devastating.
dialogue.en: The defeat was far too devastating.

dialogue.text: Venice is lost and Prussia will ascend to become the new dominant force in Germany.
dialogue.zh: Venice is lost and Prussia will ascend to become the new dominant force in Germany.
dialogue.ja: ヴェネツィアは失われ、プロイセンがドイツの新たな支配勢力として台頭します。
dialogue.local: Venice is lost and Prussia will ascend to become the new dominant force in Germany.
dialogue.en: Venice is lost and Prussia will ascend to become the new dominant force in Germany.

dialogue.text: Your Majesty, we have no other choice than so be it. This is a twist in the plan.
dialogue.zh: Your Majesty, we have no other choice than so be it. This is a twist in the plan.
dialogue.ja: 陛下、他に選択肢はありません。これが計画の転機です。
dialogue.local: Your Majesty, we have no other choice than so be it. This is a twist in the plan.
dialogue.en: Your Majesty, we have no other choice than so be it. This is a twist in the plan.

dialogue.text: One year later, the unexpected happens. Franz Joseph agrees.
dialogue.zh: One year later, the unexpected happens. Franz Joseph agrees.
dialogue.ja: 1年後、予期せぬことが起こりました。フランツ・ヨーゼフが同意しました。
dialogue.local: One year later, the unexpected happens. Franz Joseph agrees.
dialogue.en: One year later, the unexpected happens. Franz Joseph agrees.

dialogue.text: In June 1867, they parade through Budapest in the Golden Coronation carriage.
dialogue.zh: In June 1867, they parade through Budapest in the Golden Coronation carriage.
dialogue.ja: 1867年6月、彼らは黄金の戴冠馬車でブダペストをパレードしました。
dialogue.local: In June 1867, they parade through Budapest in the Golden Coronation carriage.
dialogue.en: In June 1867, they parade through Budapest in the Golden Coronation carriage.

dialogue.text: Elizabeth is 30 years old and in her prime.
dialogue.zh: Elizabeth is 30 years old and in her prime.
dialogue.ja: エリザベートは30歳で、最盛期にあります。
dialogue.local: Elizabeth is 30 years old and in her prime.
dialogue.en: Elizabeth is 30 years old and in her prime.

dialogue.text: She is wearing a magnificent dress in the Hungarian style.
dialogue.zh: She is wearing a magnificent dress in the Hungarian style.
dialogue.ja: 彼女は華麗なハンガリー風のドレスを着ています。
dialogue.local: She is wearing a magnificent dress in the Hungarian style.
dialogue.en: She is wearing a magnificent dress in the Hungarian style.

dialogue.text: Cheer erupts, the crowd celebrates their beloved queen.
dialogue.zh: Cheer erupts, the crowd celebrates their beloved queen.
dialogue.ja: 歓声が上がり、群衆は愛される女王を祝いました。
dialogue.local: Cheer erupts, the crowd celebrates their beloved queen.
dialogue.en: Cheer erupts, the crowd celebrates their beloved queen.

dialogue.text: This is her triumph, Sissy's political peak and her second home.
dialogue.zh: This is her triumph, Sissy's political peak and her second home.
dialogue.ja: これは彼女の勝利であり、シシィの政治的な絶頂であり、彼女の第二の故郷です。
dialogue.local: This is her triumph, Sissy's political peak and her second home.
dialogue.en: This is her triumph, Sissy's political peak and her second home.

dialogue.text: In gratitude, the Hungarians gift her Godolo castle, a paradise full of horses, forests and hunts.
dialogue.zh: In gratitude, the Hungarians gift her Godolo castle, a paradise full of horses, forests and hunts.
dialogue.ja: 感謝の意を込めて、ハンガリー人は彼女に馬や森、狩猟に満ちたゴドロ城を贈りました。
dialogue.local: In gratitude, the Hungarians gift her Godolo castle, a paradise full of horses, forests and hunts.
dialogue.en: In gratitude, the Hungarians gift her Godolo castle, a paradise full of horses, forests and hunts.

dialogue.text: In 1868, her youngest daughter, Marie Valerie, is born there, known as the Hungarian child.
dialogue.zh: In 1868, her youngest daughter, Marie Valerie, is born there, known as the Hungarian child.
dialogue.ja: 1868年、彼女の末娘マリー・ヴァレリーがそこで生まれ、ハンガリーの子供として知られています。
dialogue.local: In 1868, her youngest daughter, Marie Valerie, is born there, known as the Hungarian child.
dialogue.en: In 1868, her youngest daughter, Marie Valerie, is born there, known as the Hungarian child.

dialogue.text: This time, Elizabeth is allowed to decide about the upbringing and her life,
dialogue.zh: This time, Elizabeth is allowed to decide about the upbringing and her life,
dialogue.ja: 今回はエリザベートが子育てや自分の生活について決定することが許されました。
dialogue.local: This time, Elizabeth is allowed to decide about the upbringing and her life,
dialogue.en: This time, Elizabeth is allowed to decide about the upbringing and her life,

dialogue.text: at last a child truly belongs to her.
dialogue.zh: at last a child truly belongs to her.
dialogue.ja: ついに子供が本当に彼女のものとなりました。
dialogue.local: at last a child truly belongs to her.
dialogue.en: at last a child truly belongs to her.

dialogue.text: Yet this victory is not without its shadows.
dialogue.zh: Yet this victory is not without its shadows.
dialogue.ja: しかし、この勝利には影もあります。
dialogue.local: Yet this victory is not without its shadows.
dialogue.en: Yet this victory is not without its shadows.

dialogue.text: The closeness to Valerie only intensifies the estrangement from Gisela and Rudolph.
dialogue.zh: The closeness to Valerie only intensifies the estrangement from Gisela and Rudolph.
dialogue.ja: ヴァレリーとの親密さは、ギーゼラとルドルフとの疎遠をさらに強めました。
dialogue.local: The closeness to Valerie only intensifies the estrangement from Gisela and Rudolph.
dialogue.en: The closeness to Valerie only intensifies the estrangement from Gisela and Rudolph.

dialogue.text: From childhood, Elizabeth adored horseback riding, a passion she shared with Franz Joseph.
dialogue.zh: From childhood, Elizabeth adored horseback riding, a passion she shared with Franz Joseph.
dialogue.ja: 子供の頃からエリザベートは乗馬を愛しており、それはフランツ・ヨーゼフと共有する情熱でした。
dialogue.local: From childhood, Elizabeth adored horseback riding, a passion she shared with Franz Joseph.
dialogue.en: From childhood, Elizabeth adored horseback riding, a passion she shared with Franz Joseph.

dialogue.text: In Vienna's Prussia, her rides become a sensation, drawing eager crowds.
dialogue.zh: In Vienna's Prussia, her rides become a sensation, drawing eager crowds.
dialogue.ja: ウィーンのプロイセンでは、彼女の乗馬は話題となり、多くの人々を惹きつけました。
dialogue.local: In Vienna's Prussia, her rides become a sensation, drawing eager crowds.
dialogue.en: In Vienna's Prussia, her rides become a sensation, drawing eager crowds.

dialogue.text: Everything is perfectly matched, dress, hat, horse, a performance like theatre.
dialogue.zh: Everything is perfectly matched, dress, hat, horse, a performance like theatre.
dialogue.ja: すべてが完璧に調和しており、ドレス、帽子、馬、まるで劇場のようなパフォーマンスでした。
dialogue.local: Everything is perfectly matched, dress, hat, horse, a performance like theatre.
dialogue.en: Everything is perfectly matched, dress, hat, horse, a performance like theatre.

dialogue.text: After the coronation, Godolo becomes her riding haven.
dialogue.zh: After the coronation, Godolo becomes her riding haven.
dialogue.ja: 戴冠式の後、ゴドロは彼女の乗馬の聖地となりました。
dialogue.local: After the coronation, Godolo becomes her riding haven.
dialogue.en: After the coronation, Godolo becomes her riding haven.

dialogue.text: She trains with circus riders, leaps through hoops, gallops cross country, often as the only woman admired for her boldness.
dialogue.zh: She trains with circus riders, leaps through hoops, gallops cross country, often as the only woman admired for her boldness.
dialogue.ja: 彼女はサーカスの騎手と訓練し、輪を飛び越え、クロスカントリーで疾走し、しばしば大胆さで称賛される唯一の女性でした。
dialogue.local: She trains with circus riders, leaps through hoops, gallops cross country, often as the only woman admired for her boldness.
dialogue.en: She trains with circus riders, leaps through hoops, gallops cross country, often as the only woman admired for her boldness.

dialogue.text: Riding becomes her elixir of life and her weapon against the confines of the court.
dialogue.zh: Riding becomes her elixir of life and her weapon against the confines of the court.
dialogue.ja: 乗馬は彼女の命の霊薬となり、宮廷の束縛に対抗する武器となりました。
dialogue.local: Riding becomes her elixir of life and her weapon against the confines of the court.
dialogue.en: Riding becomes her elixir of life and her weapon against the confines of the court.

dialogue.text: After her triumph, Elizabeth was restless.
dialogue.zh: After her triumph, Elizabeth was restless.
dialogue.ja: 勝利の後、エリザベートは落ち着きませんでした。
dialogue.local: After her triumph, Elizabeth was restless.
dialogue.en: After her triumph, Elizabeth was restless.

dialogue.text: Hungary was her paradise, but she wanted more.
dialogue.zh: Hungary was her paradise, but she wanted more.
dialogue.ja: ハンガリーは彼女の楽園でしたが、彼女はもっと望んでいました。
dialogue.local: Hungary was her paradise, but she wanted more.
dialogue.en: Hungary was her paradise, but she wanted more.

dialogue.text: New challenges, new escapes.
dialogue.zh: New challenges, new escapes.
dialogue.ja: 新たな挑戦、新たな逃避。
dialogue.local: New challenges, new escapes.
dialogue.en: New challenges, new escapes.

dialogue.text: The heart of equestrian art was in England, Fox Hunt's risky bold, a sport for the elite.
dialogue.zh: The heart of equestrian art was in England, Fox Hunt's risky bold, a sport for the elite.
dialogue.ja: 馬術芸術の中心はイングランドにあり、フォックスハントは大胆で危険な、エリートのスポーツでした。
dialogue.local: The heart of equestrian art was in England, Fox Hunt's risky bold, a sport for the elite.
dialogue.en: The heart of equestrian art was in England, Fox Hunt's risky bold, a sport for the elite.

dialogue.text: In 1874, under the pretext that the six-year-old Valerie needed C.A.,
dialogue.zh: In 1874, under the pretext that the six-year-old Valerie needed C.A.,
dialogue.ja: 1874年、6歳のヴァレリーがC.A.を必要としているという口実で、
dialogue.local: In 1874, under the pretext that the six-year-old Valerie needed C.A.,
dialogue.en: In 1874, under the pretext that the six-year-old Valerie needed C.A.,

dialogue.text: the 37-year-old Empress traveled to England and Ireland.
dialogue.zh: the 37-year-old Empress traveled to England and Ireland.
dialogue.ja: 37歳の皇后はイングランドとアイルランドを訪れました。
dialogue.local: the 37-year-old Empress traveled to England and Ireland.
dialogue.en: the 37-year-old Empress traveled to England and Ireland.

dialogue.text: The court is appalled. She snubs Queen Victoria, yet in London, the crowds cheer her enthusiastically.
dialogue.zh: The court is appalled. She snubs Queen Victoria, yet in London, the crowds cheer her enthusiastically.
dialogue.ja: 宮廷は驚愕しました。彼女はヴィクトリア女王を無視しますが、ロンドンでは群衆が熱狂的に彼女を称えます。
dialogue.local: The court is appalled. She snubs Queen Victoria, yet in London, the crowds cheer her enthusiastically.
dialogue.en: The court is appalled. She snubs Queen Victoria, yet in London, the crowds cheer her enthusiastically.

dialogue.text: At Earl Spencer's, she meets Bay Middleton, England's most famous rider.
dialogue.zh: At Earl Spencer's, she meets Bay Middleton, England's most famous rider.
dialogue.ja: アール・スペンサーの家で、彼女はイングランドで最も有名な騎手ベイ・ミドルトンに出会います。
dialogue.local: At Earl Spencer's, she meets Bay Middleton, England's most famous rider.
dialogue.en: At Earl Spencer's, she meets Bay Middleton, England's most famous rider.

dialogue.text: Strict, relentless, precisely what she seeks.
dialogue.zh: Strict, relentless, precisely what she seeks.
dialogue.ja: 厳格で容赦ない、それがまさに彼女が求めているものでした。
dialogue.local: Strict, relentless, precisely what she seeks.
dialogue.en: Strict, relentless, precisely what she seeks.

dialogue.text: Under his training, she excels.
dialogue.zh: Under his training, she excels.
dialogue.ja: 彼の指導のもと、彼女は優れた成果を上げます。
dialogue.local: Under his training, she excels.
dialogue.en: Under his training, she excels.

dialogue.text: She races across fields through hedges, over walls, keeping pace with the leading men.
dialogue.zh: She races across fields through hedges, over walls, keeping pace with the leading men.
dialogue.ja: 彼女は野原を駆け抜け、生け垣や壁を越え、先頭の男性たちと同じペースで走ります。
dialogue.local: She races across fields through hedges, over walls, keeping pace with the leading men.
dialogue.en: She races across fields through hedges, over walls, keeping pace with the leading men.

dialogue.text: Only a few reach the goal. Elizabeth is among them.
dialogue.zh: Only a few reach the goal. Elizabeth is among them.
dialogue.ja: ゴールにたどり着くのはわずか数人で、エリザベートもその一人です。
dialogue.local: Only a few reach the goal. Elizabeth is among them.
dialogue.en: Only a few reach the goal. Elizabeth is among them.

dialogue.text: Soon it is said that no woman in Europe rides better.
dialogue.zh: Soon it is said that no woman in Europe rides better.
dialogue.ja: やがて、ヨーロッパで彼女より上手に乗る女性はいないと言われるようになります。
dialogue.local: Soon it is said that no woman in Europe rides better.
dialogue.en: Soon it is said that no woman in Europe rides better.

dialogue.text: But even here, rumours follow, conveyed by more than one teacher.
dialogue.zh: But even here, rumours follow, conveyed by more than one teacher.
dialogue.ja: しかしここでも、複数の教師から伝えられる噂がついて回ります。
dialogue.local: But even here, rumours follow, conveyed by more than one teacher.
dialogue.en: But even here, rumours follow, conveyed by more than one teacher.

dialogue.text: Most historians believe not, but Elizabeth is enthusiastic.
dialogue.zh: Most historians believe not, but Elizabeth is enthusiastic.
dialogue.ja: 多くの歴史家はそうは思いませんが、エリザベートは熱心です。
dialogue.local: Most historians believe not, but Elizabeth is enthusiastic.
dialogue.en: Most historians believe not, but Elizabeth is enthusiastic.

dialogue.text: England could have helped me in India.
dialogue.zh: England could have helped me in India.
dialogue.ja: イングランドはインドで私を助けることができたはずです。
dialogue.local: England could have helped me in India.
dialogue.en: England could have helped me in India.

dialogue.text: It's where the mine appeared of her coffin.
dialogue.zh: It's where the mine appeared of her coffin.
dialogue.ja: そこは彼女の棺の鉱山が現れた場所です。
dialogue.local: It's where the mine appeared of her coffin.
dialogue.en: It's where the mine appeared of her coffin.

dialogue.text: In 1876, when Middleton married, the 39-year-old Empress felt hurt and deeply disappointed.
dialogue.zh: In 1876, when Middleton married, the 39-year-old Empress felt hurt and deeply disappointed.
dialogue.ja: 1876年、ミドルトンが結婚したとき、39歳の皇后は傷つき、深く失望しました。
dialogue.local: In 1876, when Middleton married, the 39-year-old Empress felt hurt and deeply disappointed.
dialogue.en: In 1876, when Middleton married, the 39-year-old Empress felt hurt and deeply disappointed.

dialogue.text: She completely cuts off all contact, sells her horses and never sets foot in England again.
dialogue.zh: She completely cuts off all contact, sells her horses and never sets foot in England again.
dialogue.ja: 彼女は完全に連絡を絶ち、馬を売り、二度とイングランドに足を踏み入れませんでした。
dialogue.local: She completely cuts off all contact, sells her horses and never sets foot in England again.
dialogue.en: She completely cuts off all contact, sells her horses and never sets foot in England again.

dialogue.text: For Sissy, England stays a short-lived triumph, a chapter of glory and also of pain.
dialogue.zh: For Sissy, England stays a short-lived triumph, a chapter of glory and also of pain.
dialogue.ja: シシィにとって、イングランドは短命の勝利であり、栄光と痛みの章でした。
dialogue.local: For Sissy, England stays a short-lived triumph, a chapter of glory and also of pain.
dialogue.en: For Sissy, England stays a short-lived triumph, a chapter of glory and also of pain.

dialogue.text: Once again, she found something wonderful and lost it again.
dialogue.zh: Once again, she found something wonderful and lost it again.
dialogue.ja: 彼女は再び素晴らしいものを見つけましたが、また失ってしまいました。
dialogue.local: Once again, she found something wonderful and lost it again.
dialogue.en: Once again, she found something wonderful and lost it again.

dialogue.text: In this time of disappointment, Elizabeth finds comfort in someone who understands her.
dialogue.zh: In this time of disappointment, Elizabeth finds comfort in someone who understands her.
dialogue.ja: 失望の時期に、エリザベートは自分を理解してくれる人に慰めを見出します。
dialogue.local: In this time of disappointment, Elizabeth finds comfort in someone who understands her.
dialogue.en: In this time of disappointment, Elizabeth finds comfort in someone who understands her.

dialogue.text: While the world celebrates her as a Queen and a Questrian, she seeks something else.
dialogue.zh: While the world celebrates her as a Queen and a Questrian, she seeks something else.
dialogue.ja: 世界が彼女を女王であり騎手として称賛する一方で、彼女は別の何かを求めています。
dialogue.local: While the world celebrates her as a Queen and a Questrian, she seeks something else.
dialogue.en: While the world celebrates her as a Queen and a Questrian, she seeks something else.

dialogue.text: And she ultimately finds it with her cousin, Ludwig II of Bavaria.
dialogue.zh: And she ultimately finds it with her cousin, Ludwig II of Bavaria.
dialogue.ja: そして最終的に彼女は、いとこのバイエルンのルートヴィヒ2世のもとでそれを見つけます。
dialogue.local: And she ultimately finds it with her cousin, Ludwig II of Bavaria.
dialogue.en: And she ultimately finds it with her cousin, Ludwig II of Bavaria.

dialogue.text: Even as a child, Ludwig had admired her, now in the late.
dialogue.zh: Even as a child, Ludwig had admired her, now in the late.
dialogue.ja: 子供の頃からルートヴィヒは彼女を敬愛しており、今は晩年に差し掛かっています。
dialogue.local: Even as a child, Ludwig had admired her, now in the late.
dialogue.en: Even as a child, Ludwig had admired her, now in the late.

dialogue.text: 18th century, they meet regularly at Lake Stonberg.
dialogue.zh: 18th century, they meet regularly at Lake Stonberg.
dialogue.ja: 18世紀後半、彼らは定期的にシュトーンベルク湖で会っていました。
dialogue.local: 18th century, they meet regularly at Lake Stonberg.
dialogue.en: 18th century, they meet regularly at Lake Stonberg.

dialogue.text: I'm Purnish owner Reich.
dialogue.zh: I'm Purnish owner Reich.
dialogue.ja: 私はプルニッシュ所有者のライヒです。
dialogue.local: I'm Purnish owner Reich.
dialogue.en: I'm Purnish owner Reich.

dialogue.text: I'm Manchmet Reumann.
dialogue.zh: I'm Manchmet Reumann.
dialogue.ja: 私はマンシュメット・ロイマンです。
dialogue.local: I'm Manchmet Reumann.
dialogue.en: I'm Manchmet Reumann.

dialogue.text: Elizabeth is around 40, Ludwig in his early 30s.
dialogue.zh: Elizabeth is around 40, Ludwig in his early 30s.
dialogue.ja: エリザベートは約40歳、ルートヴィヒは30代前半です。
dialogue.local: Elizabeth is around 40, Ludwig in his early 30s.
dialogue.en: Elizabeth is around 40, Ludwig in his early 30s.

dialogue.text: Both have experienced their dreams and disappointments.
dialogue.zh: Both have experienced their dreams and disappointments.
dialogue.ja: 二人とも夢と失望を経験しています。
dialogue.local: Both have experienced their dreams and disappointments.
dialogue.en: Both have experienced their dreams and disappointments.

dialogue.text: They take a walk, exchange poems, talk about music, about Wagner, about the burden of the crown.
dialogue.zh: They take a walk, exchange poems, talk about music, about Wagner, about the burden of the crown.
dialogue.ja: 彼らは散歩をし、詩を交換し、音楽やワーグナー、王冠の重荷について語り合います。
dialogue.local: They take a walk, exchange poems, talk about music, about Wagner, about the burden of the crown.
dialogue.en: They take a walk, exchange poems, talk about music, about Wagner, about the burden of the crown.

dialogue.text: It's not romantic love, but a soul friendship.
dialogue.zh: It's not romantic love, but a soul friendship.
dialogue.ja: それは恋愛ではなく、魂の友情です。
dialogue.local: It's not romantic love, but a soul friendship.
dialogue.en: It's not romantic love, but a soul friendship.

dialogue.text: Two individuals who feel trapped inside a gilded cage.
dialogue.zh: Two individuals who feel trapped inside a gilded cage.
dialogue.ja: 金の鳥かごに閉じ込められたと感じる二人の個人です。
dialogue.local: Two individuals who feel trapped inside a gilded cage.
dialogue.en: Two individuals who feel trapped inside a gilded cage.

dialogue.text: He escapes into fairy tale castles and operas, she, into travels and horses,
dialogue.zh: He escapes into fairy tale castles and operas, she, into travels and horses,
dialogue.ja: 彼はおとぎ話の城やオペラに逃げ込み、彼女は旅と馬に没頭します。
dialogue.local: He escapes into fairy tale castles and operas, she, into travels and horses,
dialogue.en: He escapes into fairy tale castles and operas, she, into travels and horses,

dialogue.text: and both know deep down that the other understands what no one else truly grasps.
dialogue.zh: and both know deep down that the other understands what no one else truly grasps.
dialogue.ja: そして二人とも、他の誰も本当に理解していないことをお互いが理解していることを心の奥底で知っています。
dialogue.local: and both know deep down that the other understands what no one else truly grasps.
dialogue.en: and both know deep down that the other understands what no one else truly grasps.

dialogue.text: For Elizabeth, Ludwig is a mirror.
dialogue.zh: For Elizabeth, Ludwig is a mirror.
dialogue.ja: エリザベートにとって、ルートヴィヒは鏡のような存在です。
dialogue.local: For Elizabeth, Ludwig is a mirror.
dialogue.en: For Elizabeth, Ludwig is a mirror.

dialogue.text: In him, she sees how a sensitive person can crumble under the weight of the crown.
dialogue.zh: In him, she sees how a sensitive person can crumble under the weight of the crown.
dialogue.ja: 彼の中に、繊細な人が王冠の重圧で崩れ落ちる様子を見ています。
dialogue.local: In him, she sees how a sensitive person can crumble under the weight of the crown.
dialogue.en: In him, she sees how a sensitive person can crumble under the weight of the crown.

dialogue.text: And perhaps she senses that she, too, is on this path.
dialogue.zh: And perhaps she senses that she, too, is on this path.
dialogue.ja: そしておそらく、彼女もまたその道を歩んでいることを感じています。
dialogue.local: And perhaps she senses that she, too, is on this path.
dialogue.en: And perhaps she senses that she, too, is on this path.

dialogue.text: Only with Marie Valerie does Elizabeth experience what she had always longed for.
dialogue.zh: Only with Marie Valerie does Elizabeth experience what she had always longed for.
dialogue.ja: エリザベートはマリー・ヴァレリーとだけ、ずっと望んでいたものを経験します。
dialogue.local: Only with Marie Valerie does Elizabeth experience what she had always longed for.
dialogue.en: Only with Marie Valerie does Elizabeth experience what she had always longed for.

dialogue.text: Closeness, love, trust.
dialogue.zh: Closeness, love, trust.
dialogue.ja: 親密さ、愛、信頼です。
dialogue.local: Closeness, love, trust.
dialogue.en: Closeness, love, trust.

dialogue.text: She spends hours with her.
dialogue.zh: She spends hours with her.
dialogue.ja: 彼女は彼女と何時間も過ごします。
dialogue.local: She spends hours with her.
dialogue.en: She spends hours with her.

dialogue.text: They read, they play, they tell stories.
dialogue.zh: They read, they play, they tell stories.
dialogue.ja: 彼女たちは読書をし、遊び、物語を語ります。
dialogue.local: They read, they play, they tell stories.
dialogue.en: They read, they play, they tell stories.

dialogue.text: For the first time, she has control over education, clothing, teachers, and she thrives in it.
dialogue.zh: For the first time, she has control over education, clothing, teachers, and she thrives in it.
dialogue.ja: 初めて彼女は教育、服装、教師を管理し、それに満足しています。
dialogue.local: For the first time, she has control over education, clothing, teachers, and she thrives in it.
dialogue.en: For the first time, she has control over education, clothing, teachers, and she thrives in it.

dialogue.text: But this close bond also has a price.
dialogue.zh: But this close bond also has a price.
dialogue.ja: しかし、この親密な絆には代償もあります。
dialogue.local: But this close bond also has a price.
dialogue.en: But this close bond also has a price.

dialogue.text: Marie Valerie grows up in her mother's shadow,
dialogue.zh: Marie Valerie grows up in her mother's shadow,
dialogue.ja: マリー・ヴァレリーは母親の影の中で育ちます。
dialogue.local: Marie Valerie grows up in her mother's shadow,
dialogue.en: Marie Valerie grows up in her mother's shadow,

dialogue.text: over-protected, almost like a prisoner of her love.
dialogue.zh: over-protected, almost like a prisoner of her love.
dialogue.ja: 過保護に育てられ、ほとんど母の愛の囚人のようです。
dialogue.local: over-protected, almost like a prisoner of her love.
dialogue.en: over-protected, almost like a prisoner of her love.

dialogue.text: Even as an adult, she would write about herself.
dialogue.zh: Even as an adult, she would write about herself.
dialogue.ja: 大人になっても、彼女は自分自身について書いています。
dialogue.local: Even as an adult, she would write about herself.
dialogue.en: Even as an adult, she would write about herself.

dialogue.text: I never belonged to myself.
dialogue.zh: I never belonged to myself.
dialogue.ja: 私は決して自分自身のものではありませんでした。
dialogue.local: I never belonged to myself.
dialogue.en: I never belonged to myself.

dialogue.text: I was always just my mother's child.
dialogue.zh: I was always just my mother's child.
dialogue.ja: 私はいつも母の子供でした。
dialogue.local: I was always just my mother's child.
dialogue.en: I was always just my mother's child.

dialogue.text: So Valerie becomes her support, but also a burden.
dialogue.zh: So Valerie becomes her support, but also a burden.
dialogue.ja: だからヴァレリーは彼女の支えになりますが、同時に負担でもあります。
dialogue.local: So Valerie becomes her support, but also a burden.
dialogue.en: So Valerie becomes her support, but also a burden.

dialogue.text: What Elizabeth gains with her, she loses with Jisela and Rudolph.
dialogue.zh: What Elizabeth gains with her, she loses with Jisela and Rudolph.
dialogue.ja: エリザベートがヴァレリーと得るものは、ジゼラとルドルフとは失われます。
dialogue.local: What Elizabeth gains with her, she loses with Jisela and Rudolph.
dialogue.en: What Elizabeth gains with her, she loses with Jisela and Rudolph.

dialogue.text: The alienation grows.
dialogue.zh: The alienation grows.
dialogue.ja: 疎外感が増していきます。
dialogue.local: The alienation grows.
dialogue.en: The alienation grows.

dialogue.text: And friends, Joseph, he loves Elizabeth until the end, but he doesn't understand her.
dialogue.zh: And friends, Joseph, he loves Elizabeth until the end, but he doesn't understand her.
dialogue.ja: そして友人のヨーゼフは、最後までエリザベートを愛していますが、彼女を理解していません。
dialogue.local: And friends, Joseph, he loves Elizabeth until the end, but he doesn't understand her.
dialogue.en: And friends, Joseph, he loves Elizabeth until the end, but he doesn't understand her.

dialogue.text: He is a man of duty, a life in documents, audiences, armies.
dialogue.zh: He is a man of duty, a life in documents, audiences, armies.
dialogue.ja: 彼は義務の人であり、書類、謁見、軍隊の生活を送っています。
dialogue.local: He is a man of duty, a life in documents, audiences, armies.
dialogue.en: He is a man of duty, a life in documents, audiences, armies.

dialogue.text: She, on the other hand, is a woman of longing, freedom, escape.
dialogue.zh: She, on the other hand, is a woman of longing, freedom, escape.
dialogue.ja: 一方で彼女は、憧れ、自由、逃避の女性です。
dialogue.local: She, on the other hand, is a woman of longing, freedom, escape.
dialogue.en: She, on the other hand, is a woman of longing, freedom, escape.

dialogue.text: Elizabeth, blab in vain.
dialogue.zh: Elizabeth, blab in vain.
dialogue.ja: エリザベートは無駄におしゃべりします。
dialogue.local: Elizabeth, blab in vain.
dialogue.en: Elizabeth, blab in vain.

dialogue.text: He can't eat.
dialogue.zh: He can't eat.
dialogue.ja: 彼は食べられません。
dialogue.local: He can't eat.
dialogue.en: He can't eat.

dialogue.text: He keeps asking her to stay in Vienna.
dialogue.zh: He keeps asking her to stay in Vienna.
dialogue.ja: 彼は彼女にウィーンに留まるように頼み続けます。
dialogue.local: He keeps asking her to stay in Vienna.
dialogue.en: He keeps asking her to stay in Vienna.

dialogue.text: She keeps leaving.
dialogue.zh: She keeps leaving.
dialogue.ja: 彼女は何度も去っていきます。
dialogue.local: She keeps leaving.
dialogue.en: She keeps leaving.

dialogue.text: Their marriage soon becomes just letters, brief meetings, formal events.
dialogue.zh: Their marriage soon becomes just letters, brief meetings, formal events.
dialogue.ja: 彼らの結婚生活はすぐに手紙、短い会合、公式の行事だけになります。
dialogue.local: Their marriage soon becomes just letters, brief meetings, formal events.
dialogue.en: Their marriage soon becomes just letters, brief meetings, formal events.

dialogue.text: What started as a love story has turned into mere coexistence.
dialogue.zh: What started as a love story has turned into mere coexistence.
dialogue.ja: 愛の物語として始まったものが、単なる共存に変わってしまいました。
dialogue.local: What started as a love story has turned into mere coexistence.
dialogue.en: What started as a love story has turned into mere coexistence.

dialogue.text: For friends, Joseph, the Hofburg is an office, but for Elizabeth, it feels like a prison.
dialogue.zh: For friends, Joseph, the Hofburg is an office, but for Elizabeth, it feels like a prison.
dialogue.ja: 友人ヨーゼフにとってホーフブルクはオフィスですが、エリザベートにとっては監獄のように感じられます。
dialogue.local: For friends, Joseph, the Hofburg is an office, but for Elizabeth, it feels like a prison.
dialogue.en: For friends, Joseph, the Hofburg is an office, but for Elizabeth, it feels like a prison.

dialogue.text: So Elizabeth lives in two worlds, celebrated as the Queen of Hungary, admired as a rider in England,
dialogue.zh: So Elizabeth lives in two worlds, celebrated as the Queen of Hungary, admired as a rider in England,
dialogue.ja: だからエリザベートは二つの世界に生きています。ハンガリーの女王として称えられ、イングランドでは騎手として称賛されています。
dialogue.local: So Elizabeth lives in two worlds, celebrated as the Queen of Hungary, admired as a rider in England,
dialogue.en: So Elizabeth lives in two worlds, celebrated as the Queen of Hungary, admired as a rider in England,

dialogue.text: understood as Ludwig's soul mate.
dialogue.zh: understood as Ludwig's soul mate.
dialogue.ja: ルートヴィヒの魂の伴侶として理解されています。
dialogue.local: understood as Ludwig's soul mate.
dialogue.en: understood as Ludwig's soul mate.

dialogue.text: As a mother close to Valerie yet distant from her other children, and as a woman increasingly distant from her emperor.
dialogue.zh: As a mother close to Valerie yet distant from her other children, and as a woman increasingly distant from her emperor.
dialogue.ja: ヴァレリーには近い母親でありながら、他の子供たちとは距離があり、皇帝からもますます遠ざかる女性として。
dialogue.local: As a mother close to Valerie yet distant from her other children, and as a woman increasingly distant from her emperor.
dialogue.en: As a mother close to Valerie yet distant from her other children, and as a woman increasingly distant from her emperor.

dialogue.text: The shadows grow longer.
dialogue.zh: The shadows grow longer.
dialogue.ja: 影が長くなっていきます。
dialogue.local: The shadows grow longer.
dialogue.en: The shadows grow longer.

dialogue.text: She's passed 40, Rudolph now 20 carries deep scars.
dialogue.zh: She's passed 40, Rudolph now 20 carries deep scars.
dialogue.ja: 彼女は40歳を過ぎ、ルドルフは今20歳で深い傷を負っています。
dialogue.local: She's passed 40, Rudolph now 20 carries deep scars.
dialogue.en: She's passed 40, Rudolph now 20 carries deep scars.

dialogue.text: She's Ella stays cool and distant, finding her anchor solely in Marie Valerie.
dialogue.zh: She's Ella stays cool and distant, finding her anchor solely in Marie Valerie.
dialogue.ja: 彼女は冷静で距離を置き、マリー・ヴァレリーだけを支えにしています。
dialogue.local: She's Ella stays cool and distant, finding her anchor solely in Marie Valerie.
dialogue.en: She's Ella stays cool and distant, finding her anchor solely in Marie Valerie.

dialogue.text: Elizabeth seems to have triumphed, yet she grows ever more restless, constantly fleeing from country to country,
dialogue.zh: Elizabeth seems to have triumphed, yet she grows ever more restless, constantly fleeing from country to country,
dialogue.ja: エリザベートは勝利を収めたように見えますが、ますます落ち着かず、国から国へと逃げ続けています。
dialogue.local: Elizabeth seems to have triumphed, yet she grows ever more restless, constantly fleeing from country to country,
dialogue.en: Elizabeth seems to have triumphed, yet she grows ever more restless, constantly fleeing from country to country,

dialogue.text: castle to castle, as if trying to escape her own soul.
dialogue.zh: castle to castle, as if trying to escape her own soul.
dialogue.ja: 城から城へと、まるで自分の魂から逃げようとしているかのようです。
dialogue.local: castle to castle, as if trying to escape her own soul.
dialogue.en: castle to castle, as if trying to escape her own soul.

dialogue.text: The triumphs cannot fill the inner void, where this flight is heading.
dialogue.zh: The triumphs cannot fill the inner void, where this flight is heading.
dialogue.ja: 勝利は内なる空虚を満たすことができず、この逃避はその空虚へと向かっています。
dialogue.local: The triumphs cannot fill the inner void, where this flight is heading.
dialogue.en: The triumphs cannot fill the inner void, where this flight is heading.

dialogue.text: That's exactly what you'll discover in part three.
dialogue.zh: That's exactly what you'll discover in part three.
dialogue.ja: それがまさにパート3であなたが発見することです。
dialogue.local: That's exactly what you'll discover in part three.
dialogue.en: That's exactly what you'll discover in part three.
